# splunkctl es

Enterprise Security — notable-event triage (requires ES installed).

## es notables get

Get one notable event's full field set, by event_id.

```text
splunkctl es notables get [OPTIONS] EVENT_ID
```

## es notables list

List notable events (index=notable) with server-side filters.

```text
splunkctl es notables list [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--since` | text | -24h | Earliest time (default -24h). |
| `--until` | text | now | Latest time (default now). |
| `--status` | text | - | Status name or integer. |
| `--owner` | text | - | Filter by assigned owner. |
| `--rule` | text | - | Correlation search name substring. |
| `--limit` | integer range | 100 | Max results (default 100). |

## es notables update

Triage one or more notables: assign, set status/urgency/disposition, comment.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl es notables update [OPTIONS] EVENT_IDS...
```

```text
Accepts multiple EVENT_IDS for bulk triage. Requires at least one of
--status/--owner/--urgency/--disposition/--comment.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | text | - | New status: name (unassigned, new, in progress, pending, resolved, closed) or integer 0-5. |
| `--owner` | text | - | New assignee (owner). |
| `--urgency` | choice: informational, low, medium, high, critical | - | New urgency. |
| `--disposition` | text | - | ES disposition id (e.g. 'disposition:1'), passed through as-is — see your ES instance's configured dispositions. |
| `--comment` | text | - | Analyst comment. |
